ocr.label: OCR
ocr.description: Extract text, tables and Markdown from images and scanned PDFs.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: Talk to an agent or a chat model.

decision.label: Decision
decision.description: Ask typed questions about a text and get calibrated answers.

text-to-speech.label: Speech
text-to-speech.description: Turn text into natural speech, on this device or in the cloud.

speech-to-text.label: Transcribe
speech-to-text.description: Record or upload audio and get an accurate transcript.

image-tools.label: Image tools
image-tools.description: Remove backgrounds, estimate depth, detect objects and read text in images.

text-tools.label: Text tools
text-tools.description: Classify text, sort it into your own labels and rank documents by relevance.

text-to-audio.label: Audio
text-to-audio.description: Generate audio clips, such as music or sound, from a prompt.
